title: Rogue Wax Works Dynavap Debowler & Tamper
description:
Rogue Wax Works Debowler & Tamper
A perfect tool to accompany your Dynavap experience. The tamper end is the perfect size to tamp down your bowl while the opposite end will help you empty the spent herb out of the bowl.
While this tool has been specifically designed for dynavap it can of course be used with many other vaporizers.
Included
1 X Rogue Wax Works Debowler & Tamper Tool
